description:
A multi-factor authentication configuration section.
Shows the current MFA status and allows enabling, disabling, or reconfiguring MFA.
Uses FormSection for consistent layout.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Called when the user toggles MFA on or off.

props.name: onSetup
props.description: Called when the user initiates MFA setup or reconfiguration.

props.name: method
props.description: The currently active MFA method, or null if none.
